snippet.title: PANIK | Announcement trailer
snippet.description:
- Don’t panic!
PANIK is a puzzle game where you have to guide different characters to the goal. Sounds easy... but, can you manage it without panicking?

- The panikers are scared and can’t move!
Find out how to calm these creatures and guide them to safety. Complete over 100 levels spread across 8 unique worlds and uncover all the challenges.

- Meet the panikers!
Have you seen the one wearing a crown? What about the one with the magician’s hat? Or the robot? There’s even a ninja! Each one has unique abilities to help (or not) you solve each puzzle.

- Features:
-Over 100 levels spread across 8 worlds.
-14 panikers with unique abilities. (Or maybe it's 15?)
-Minimalist style.
-A bit of humor.
-Lots of panik!

------------------------------

More info here: https://linktr.ee/PANIK_GAME
